scope: Increment A P4 documents and gates

database.mode: Real PostgreSQL with rollback-only fault injection; commands execute as athyperapp.
checks: Direct application job updates are denied
Decision document blocks materialization, not approval (isolated transition fixture)
Activation document blocks closure, not running cycle (isolated transition fixture)
Repeated failure after explicit retry has a distinct durable event
Gate failure preserves artifact and retries without a render
All provider and callback failures preserve case business state

lastResume.reviewerSession: authenticated catl.owner; reviewer downloads and 13 committed votes verified
lastResume.result: All three purpose journeys qualified for three profiles; controlled upstream activation fixture declared
fixes: Shared canonical address reuse preserves links/lineage
Qualification uses canonical materialize relay and matching vote idempotency keys

qualificationBoundary: P4 activation consumption uses controlled upstream risk/company fixtures, real qualification/readiness/lifecycle repositories and committed activation evidence; authenticated document APIs, real rendering/scanning/storage. P6, payment readiness and full upstream approval workflows are not claimed.

activationFixtures.mode: Controlled upstream risk/company/qualification fixture for synthetic DEV P2 suppliers; real readiness resolver and existing supplier activation repository. No claim of authenticated P6 risk/company approval.

liveActivationDocuments.mode: Authenticated P4 activation document API with controlled upstream fixture and real owner activation evidence

committedOutcomes.mode: Read-only verification of committed authenticated reviews/materialization and controlled upstream P4 activation fixtures

materializerContract.mode: Canonical materializer guard evaluated in PostgreSQL against cloned in-memory decision payload; no persisted snapshot changes
